verdict.rationale: Skills can run without a UI in several documented ways. They can be attached programmatically to Messages API requests through the `container` parameter (up to 20 per request) and uploaded or managed through the Skills API. Agent SDK sessions can control, dispatch and discover skills, and can load plugins from local directories in code. Claude Code also has a non-interactive `claude -p` mode for piped input. missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs (e.g. a GitHub Actions or pipeline recipe for skills), any documented headless skill invocation via `claude -p`, and independent hands-on corroboration of skills running in automated pipelines.
